description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguage entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It maps employee language skills, including fluency, competency, and comments, to the database and provides getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: Represents an employee's language skill record, including fluency, competency, and comments, linked to Employee and Language entities.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this language record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this language record.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the Language associated with this record.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the Language for this record.

methods.name: setFluency
methods.description: Sets the fluency level, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: setCompetency
methods.description: Sets the competency level, throws exception if invalid.
